name: Sir Hollowell
place: patrols the broken keep wall at Ashcombe, still on guard for a lord dead two hundred years
_doc: Stream E (M2). A knight who does not know he is dead. He issues a challenge (a marked player must stay inside a circle that follows them, away from friends), swings a cross of steel, and at half health raises his old garrison — two bone hounds — and starts swinging every other breath.

party.solo: Hard solo: the challenge circle plus hounds hurts at level 5.
party.full: Easy; interrupt the rally every time.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: Halt! Who goes there? State your name and business with Lord Ashcombe!
You are not on the list. Nobody is on the list.
say.death: Sir Hollowell kneels. "Relieved... of duty." The armour falls in a heap.
say.reset: Sir Hollowell resumes his patrol along the wall.

challenge.name: Formal Challenge
challenge.say: "{target}! I challenge you!" — stand apart from the others!

steel_cross.name: Cross of Steel
steel_cross.say: Sir Hollowell plants his blade and turns.

rally.name: Rally the Wall
rally.say: Sir Hollowell calls for the garrison — interrupt him!

onInterrupt.say: His call ends in a dusty cough.
